items.title: Same-model self-critique is proof of correctness
items.why_it_fails: The generator can share the exact blind spot it is asked to detect; intrinsic self-correction has mixed/negative evidence.
items.preferred_alternative: Use reflection to generate hypotheses, then verify with tests, tools, retrieval, independent evidence, or calibrated external graders.

items.title: Majority vote means truth
items.why_it_fails: Multiple samples/models can share correlated training errors; agreement measures consistency, not correctness.
items.preferred_alternative: Use deterministic/reference evidence where possible; calibrate disagreement and preserve abstention.

items.title: More agents are automatically better
items.why_it_fails: Agent fan-out adds coordination, duplicated exploration, context transfer and large token multipliers; tightly coupled work often suffers.
items.preferred_alternative: Fan out only independent work with measurable breadth/latency benefit and enforce budgets/dedupe.

items.title: A specialist agent is just a different persona prompt
items.why_it_fails: Role labels without distinct tools, context, policy, capability or evals create maintenance without real specialization.
items.preferred_alternative: Represent specialists as capability profiles with measurable differences.

items.title: Bigger context window eliminates retrieval/memory design
items.why_it_fails: Nominal capacity does not guarantee useful attention, and long inputs still increase cost, latency, stale context and positional failures.
items.preferred_alternative: Use selective retrieval, progressive disclosure, compaction and long-context behavioral evals.

items.title: Dump the entire conversation/project into every prompt
items.why_it_fails: Most context becomes repeated overhead and can obscure relevant constraints.
items.preferred_alternative: Retrieve task-specific slices and measure context utility/ablation.

items.title: Retrieve more documents to improve RAG
items.why_it_fails: Additional low-relevance evidence can decrease precision and confuse generation.
items.preferred_alternative: Optimize recall at candidate stage, then filter/rerank and cap context by measured utility.

items.title: Embeddings replace lexical search
items.why_it_fails: Dense retrieval can miss exact IDs, error strings, names and rare terminology.
items.preferred_alternative: Use lexical + dense hybrid routes and task-specific ablations.

items.title: GraphRAG/knowledge graph should index everything
items.why_it_fails: Graph construction, entity resolution, summaries and refresh can cost more than the query benefit for local lookup.
items.preferred_alternative: Benchmark graph-specific global/relational queries against hybrid text + typed edges first.

items.title: A summary can replace its source
items.why_it_fails: Summaries are lossy derived state and can preserve/compound an earlier error.
items.preferred_alternative: Keep canonical evidence addressable; summaries point back to exact sources and can be rebuilt.

items.title: Memory should remember everything forever
items.why_it_fails: Unbounded retention increases retrieval noise, privacy exposure and stale/conflicting facts.
items.preferred_alternative: Separate evidence from active memory; archive/demote/supersede using retention policy.

items.title: One user action is a durable global preference
items.why_it_fails: Preferences are often context-, domain- and time-dependent.
items.preferred_alternative: Stage candidates, track recurrence/context, and promote only with explicit or repeated evidence.

items.title: Overwrite old memory when a fact changes
items.why_it_fails: Destructive overwrite loses historical truth and why a decision was made.
items.preferred_alternative: Use supersession/validity intervals and provenance-preserving reconsolidation.

items.title: A generic intelligence score should decide model routing
items.why_it_fails: Aggregate benchmarks hide task family, reliability, latency, tools, privacy and version-specific behavior.
items.preferred_alternative: Route on Agent-OS task-specific measured distributions with generic scores only as priors.

items.title: Public leaderboard winner is the production winner
items.why_it_fails: Benchmark contamination, task mismatch and scaffolding differences can reverse rankings on real workloads.
items.preferred_alternative: Use private task corpus and champion/challenger shadow evaluation.

items.title: Model aliases are reproducible evidence
items.why_it_fails: Aliases can silently point to a new model/revision.
items.preferred_alternative: Record resolved concrete model/version and revalidate when it changes.

items.title: Use the strongest model for every call
items.why_it_fails: Many tasks are deterministic/simple and do not benefit enough to justify frontier cost/latency.
items.preferred_alternative: Use validators and constrained routing to choose the cheapest eligible path.

items.title: Fine-tune before fixing data/context/tools/evals
items.why_it_fails: Training adds data governance, rollback and behavioral opacity and may solve a problem caused by poor scaffolding.
items.preferred_alternative: Prefer deterministic code, retrieval, prompts, tools and routing first; fine-tune after measured plateau.

items.title: More training examples are always better
items.why_it_fails: Noisy/duplicate data can waste compute and reduce quality; selection/curation can outperform full sets.
items.preferred_alternative: Deduplicate, filter and evaluate data quality/coverage.

items.title: Recursive synthetic data can replace real data indefinitely
items.why_it_fails: Repeated training on generated distributions can lose tails and amplify model errors.
items.preferred_alternative: Preserve real/verified anchors, provenance, diversity and external holdouts.

items.title: Model-edit personal/current facts into weights
items.why_it_fails: Parametric editing is less auditable/reversible and mass/sequential edits can degrade capabilities.
items.preferred_alternative: Keep mutable knowledge external and retrieved with provenance.

items.title: Continual fine-tuning can learn forever without regressions
items.why_it_fails: Sequential updates can catastrophically forget earlier capabilities and preferences.
items.preferred_alternative: Use regression replay/adapters and external memory; test old tasks after every adaptation.

items.title: Ask an LLM to calculate/query what deterministic software can compute
items.why_it_fails: Generative reasoning adds cost and error where code/SQL/solver provides an exact result.
items.preferred_alternative: Compile interpretation into deterministic query/program/solver and validate semantics.

items.title: A solver returning a valid solution proves the user request was understood
items.why_it_fails: Solvers prove properties of the formal specification, not semantic fidelity of model-generated formalization.
items.preferred_alternative: Validate source→spec coverage, assumptions, units and high-risk spec diffs.

items.title: Model output should decide authorization
items.why_it_fails: A compromised/mistaken model can simply reason itself into broader authority.
items.preferred_alternative: Keep default-deny authorization deterministic and external to the model.

items.title: Prompt instructions are a sufficient prompt-injection defense
items.why_it_fails: Untrusted content can still influence the same model that chooses actions.
items.preferred_alternative: Separate trusted control from untrusted data and enforce data/capability flow at tool boundaries.

items.title: Put secrets in model context because the model needs the tool
items.why_it_fails: The tool adapter can authenticate without exposing credential bytes to the model/log.
items.preferred_alternative: Keep secrets in trusted adapters and expose opaque capabilities.

items.title: Retry every failure
items.why_it_fails: Auth/schema/policy errors are deterministic and repeated retries waste time/cost or duplicate effects.
items.preferred_alternative: Classify errors; retry only transient failures with bounded backoff.

items.title: Layered libraries should each retry independently
items.why_it_fails: Nested retries multiply attempts and can create retry storms.
items.preferred_alternative: Have one owner for retry policy per operation path.

items.title: Retry a write without idempotency
items.why_it_fails: A timeout after server commit can cause duplicate message/payment/record on retry.
items.preferred_alternative: Persist operation identity and use idempotency/readback.

items.title: Silently truncate context when over limit
items.why_it_fails: The dropped portion may contain binding goals, approvals or constraints.
items.preferred_alternative: Fail closed or explicitly compact with protected state and tests.

items.title: Provider compaction becomes canonical memory
items.why_it_fails: Provider summaries are derived/model-specific and may be lossy or unavailable later.
items.preferred_alternative: Keep canonical state external; compaction is ephemeral execution optimization.

items.title: Confident wording is calibrated confidence
items.why_it_fails: Fluency/tone is not a probability of correctness.
items.preferred_alternative: Use outcome-calibrated uncertainty, evidence and validators.

items.title: Raw self-reported probability is safe to show users
items.why_it_fails: P(True)/verbal confidence can drift OOD and shares model blind spots.
items.preferred_alternative: Calibrate on task outcomes and use it mainly for internal routing/abstention.

items.title: LLM judge scores are objective ground truth
items.why_it_fails: Judges show position/style/verbosity/model biases and may share generator errors.
items.preferred_alternative: Calibrate against humans/deterministic checks, randomize order and preserve disagreement.

items.title: Several LLM judges create independent evidence
items.why_it_fails: Correlated models/data can amplify the same bias; debate can amplify rather than cancel it.
items.preferred_alternative: Measure judge correlation/disagreement and anchor with different evidence types.

items.title: Let the optimizer repeatedly inspect the protected holdout
items.why_it_fails: Adaptive reuse overfits evaluation even without gradient training.
items.preferred_alternative: Keep holdout behind promotion service, limit adaptive access, refresh cases.

items.title: A benchmark remains valid forever
items.why_it_fails: Tasks, providers, dependencies and user workloads drift.
items.preferred_alternative: Version suites, maintain frozen anchors + rolling frontier cases, and revalidate on external change.

items.title: One aggregate score describes system quality
items.why_it_fails: Averages can hide catastrophic security/reliability/subgroup failures.
items.preferred_alternative: Use a small set of primary outcomes plus hard guardrails and diagnostic breakdowns.

items.title: Optimize clicks, accepts, or notification engagement as user value
items.why_it_fails: The agent can learn to be interruptive/persuasive rather than useful.
items.preferred_alternative: Optimize durable goal completion/user effort and treat engagement as diagnostic.

items.title: Surface every potentially useful proactive idea
items.why_it_fails: High recall creates alert fatigue and teaches the user to ignore the system.
items.preferred_alternative: Use expected utility, interruption cost, batching, novelty suppression and do-nothing action.

items.title: Always run a critic/challenger
items.why_it_fails: Permanent critique wastes tokens and becomes contrarian/noisy.
items.preferred_alternative: Trigger challenge at high-impact assumptions and suppress repeats unless evidence changes.

items.title: One user correction should silently rewrite production behavior
items.why_it_fails: Corrections can be situational or mistaken.
items.preferred_alternative: Capture as learning evidence; create candidate/regression and promote after validation.

items.title: Commit high-frequency telemetry/raw events to Git
items.why_it_fails: Noisy mutable data bloats history, leaks sensitive content and creates merge debt.
items.preferred_alternative: Keep high-frequency/private telemetry local; commit reviewed schemas/aggregates/decisions.

items.title: Log full prompts/tool outputs by default for observability
items.why_it_fails: Sensitive content and secrets can enter traces; more logs are not automatically better.
items.preferred_alternative: Record structured redacted metadata by default; content capture is explicit/local/policy-controlled.

items.title: Event-source every piece of state
items.why_it_fails: Full histories add schema-migration, storage and privacy cost where a materialized current value is sufficient.
items.preferred_alternative: Reserve event history for audit-critical/replayable workflows; caches remain derived.

items.title: Adopt a workflow engine/vector DB/graph DB because the category is fashionable
items.why_it_fails: Infrastructure has permanent operational cost and can duplicate solved capabilities.
items.preferred_alternative: Define adoption threshold and benchmark existing simpler primitives first.

items.title: Build a new subsystem instead of extending an existing primitive
items.why_it_fails: Parallel candidate/memory/telemetry/routing systems create multiple sources of truth.
items.preferred_alternative: Map capabilities/dependencies and extend/consolidate unless requirements truly differ.

items.title: Preserve a component because much work has already gone into it
items.why_it_fails: Sunk cost is not future value.
items.preferred_alternative: Shadow-disable, regression-test and delete/replace if current evidence no longer justifies it.

items.title: Code coverage proves correctness
items.why_it_fails: Coverage measures exercised paths, not whether assertions/specification are adequate.
items.preferred_alternative: Combine coverage with properties, differential/metamorphic oracles, sanitizers and mutation tests.

items.title: Fuzz a slow nondeterministic model call like a byte parser
items.why_it_fails: Coverage-guided fuzzing depends on fast deterministic targets and meaningful feedback.
items.preferred_alternative: Fuzz parsers/schemas/policies; use metamorphic/adversarial suites for model behavior.

items.title: A metamorphic relation is automatically a valid oracle
items.why_it_fails: A supposedly meaning-preserving transformation may actually change the task.
items.preferred_alternative: Validate relations/domain assumptions and track false positives.

items.title: Federated learning means private learning
items.why_it_fails: Model updates can leak information and federated training only reduces raw-data centralization.
items.preferred_alternative: Threat-model updates; add secure aggregation/DP when those guarantees are actually needed.

items.title: Differential privacy means anonymous/safe data
items.why_it_fails: DP gives a quantified participation/privacy guarantee under a precise mechanism; implementation and utility hazards remain.
items.preferred_alternative: Specify mechanism/accountant/budget and follow formal guidance; do not use 'DP' as vague privacy label.

items.title: Use CRDTs for every synchronized object
items.why_it_fails: CRDT convergence does not guarantee domain-semantic correctness; some conflicts require explicit review.
items.preferred_alternative: Use CRDTs only where merge semantics are mathematically appropriate.

items.title: Explore online on consequential user actions to learn faster
items.why_it_fails: Bandit exploration can intentionally choose suboptimal actions; unacceptable for spending/security/communications.
items.preferred_alternative: Restrict exploration to reversible low-risk presentation/routing choices with hard policy constraints.

items.title: Implicit feedback directly reveals user preference
items.why_it_fails: Observed behavior is confounded by what the current policy chose to show and by delay/context.
items.preferred_alternative: Log propensities/context, preserve controls and distinguish explicit from inferred preference.

items.title: Distribution drift always requires retraining
items.why_it_fails: Input distribution can change without hurting task performance; retraining can add risk.
items.preferred_alternative: Monitor direct quality first and use drift as diagnostic/trigger for re-evaluation.

items.title: Quantization/pruning percentage equals real speedup
items.why_it_fails: Hardware kernels, batch size and memory bandwidth determine wall-clock gains; quality can degrade on harder tasks.
items.preferred_alternative: Benchmark exact deployment hardware/task suite and cost per successful task.

items.title: Nominal two-million-token context equals two-million-token useful memory
items.why_it_fails: Context-extension methods can preserve perplexity/passkey tests while real multi-hop/positional reasoning remains weaker.
items.preferred_alternative: Run task-specific usable-context/position/latency tests and retain external memory.

items.title: Cache results without exact dependency/version lineage
items.why_it_fails: A fast stale answer can be worse than recomputation.
items.preferred_alternative: Content-address plus relevant processor/model/index/source versions and invalidate downstream selectively.

items.title: Treat a cache as source of truth
items.why_it_fails: Caches are optimizations and may be deleted, stale or partially built.
items.preferred_alternative: Canonical state must survive cold-cache rebuild.

items.title: Expose every tool schema eagerly
items.why_it_fails: Large rare tool catalogs consume context/cache and can degrade selection.
items.preferred_alternative: Eager-load common tools; defer/search rare namespaces where supported.

items.title: One mega-tool with dozens of loosely related modes is simpler
items.why_it_fails: Broad tools create ambiguous selection, argument combinations and authorization surfaces.
items.preferred_alternative: Expose task-oriented operations with shared adapter internals.

items.title: Return full API/search payloads to the model
items.why_it_fails: Verbose results consume context and make important fields harder to identify.
items.preferred_alternative: Return compact typed high-signal data + stable handle for details.

items.title: Generate free-form JSON and repair it with regex
items.why_it_fails: Post-hoc parsing retries are fragile when schema-constrained generation is available.
items.preferred_alternative: Use strict structured/grammar output plus semantic validation.

items.title: Force a prediction when evidence is insufficient
items.why_it_fails: No abstain path converts uncertainty into confident errors or unsafe actions.
items.preferred_alternative: Explicitly support unknown/retrieve/escalate/ask states and tune risk-coverage.

items.title: Research until every possible source is read
items.why_it_fails: Marginal evidence can stop changing the decision while cost/noise keeps growing.
items.preferred_alternative: Use value-of-information stopping while recording unresolved frontier/questions.

items.title: Research radar should promote every new model/paper
items.why_it_fails: Novelty chasing creates roadmap churn and architectural debt.
items.preferred_alternative: Promote only when it addresses measured weakness, replaces complexity, or enables high-value missing capability.

items.title: The self-improvement engine can modify its own safety/eval gates in the same experiment
items.why_it_fails: Optimizer can game its objective by weakening the measurement or constraint.
items.preferred_alternative: Separate suggestion/change rights from independent immutable gates and holdouts.
